description: A storm courier dashes between four numbered lightning shrines while stone sentinels guard the routes. Survive the growing tempest, then escape through a grounded arch. Use a divided ritual arena and electric teal and gold pixel art.

identity.dramaticPressure: Temporal tempest intensifies while guards watch.
identity.fantasy: A courier battles a storm to deliver lightning shrines, guided by the pulse of a ritual arena.
identity.signatureMechanic: Dash between numbered shrines, completing them in sequence.

title: Storm Courier
